final: WITH phase_averages AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_bandwidth FROM phase_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth), SUM(p.telescope_count), AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - overall.mean_bandwidth) FROM phase_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > overall.mean_bandwidth
